answer: Siemens reported fiscal-2025 total gross indirect Scope 3 emissions of 159,144 ktCO2e, of which Category 3.11 use of sold products was 134,133 ktCO2e. Category 3.11 is calculated at portfolio-element level for relevant products physically handed to customers, using assumptions for product use, specifications and use-phase duration. It excludes sold-software use where not already covered by Scope 1, Scope 2 or Category 3.1 because no standardized market practice exists. Electricity uses IEA factors and other fuels use DESNZ/DEFRA factors. Across all calculated Scope 3 categories, primary data accounted for 0%, so the values rely on modeled assumptions and factors rather than primary data.

normalized_value.category_3_11_boundary: relevant offerings physically handed over to customers, calculated at portfolio-element level
normalized_value.software_exclusion: sold software use excluded where not already addressed in Scope 1, Scope 2 or Scope 3.1

evidence.quote: Calculations are completed at a portfolio element
Primary data was used to calculate 0% of the calculated Scope 3 GHG emissions across all categories.
